functions.description: Link list elements by type order
functions.notes: Logic and instruction shapes reconstructed (bitfield flags byte at 0x50, two element arrays, byte type lists copied from data_ov004_0216ff98+6 and data_ov004_0216ffa1, chained via field 8). Remaining difference is register allocation: target keeps obj in r4, e in r0, i in lr, t in r5, pushes only r3-r7; ours puts obj in r6, e/i in r4/r5 and needs r8 (2 words short). Declaration order, loop form, t type and flat-vs-nested conditions did not change it. colorsweep only offered an iroalign attribute and a semantically wrong reorder, both rejected.
